text: DEFONEOS — DHSC NHS Procurement & Supply Chain AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠️ EU AI Act Article 50 Compliance Pack — High-risk AI systems in public health procurement require mandatory transparency, human oversight, and conformity assessment before deployment across NHS supply chains. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DHSC × NHS Supply Chain × Procurement DHSC NHS Procurement & Supply Chain AI Deep-Dive Sovereign AI governance for NHS procurement intelligence — from supply chain optimisation and clinical device risk to pharmaceutical cost management and counter-fraud detection. Article 50 compliant, human-governed, outcome-assured. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Supply Chain NHS Supply Chain National procurement hub managing category management, demand aggregation, and catalogue operations across NHS trusts. Centralises spend visibility, contract leverage, and supply resilience for 230+ NHS organisations. Covers £8bn+ annual spend across food, clinical consumables, capital medical equipment, and logistics services. Clinical Clinical Procurement Medical devices, PPE, and consumables procurement with clinical preference evaluation. Covers MHRA registration, MDR/IVDR compliance, and product standardisation across acute and community settings. Digital Digital Procurement NHS IT systems procurement including EPR, PACS, and digital clinical solutions via CCS frameworks. Accelerates trust-level digital maturity through standardised procurement routes and interoperability requirements. Pharma Pharmaceutical NHS medicines procurement through NICE technology appraisals, biosimilar switching programmes, and managed entry agreements. Balances cost optimisation with clinical efficacy and patient access timelines. Manages £18bn+ annual medicines spend with complex pricing and rebate structures. Estates Estates & Facilities NHS property management including PFI handback, energy procurement, FM contracts, and New Hospital Programme construction. Drives Net Zero targets through green energy sourcing and sustainable building standards. Manages £9bn+ estate with 1,400+ NHS sites requiring decarbonisation and modernisation. Commissioning Commissioning ICB-level procurement for elective recovery, community services, and specialised commissioning. Aligns commissioning decisions with integrated care strategies, population health outcomes, and financial sustainability. Capital Capital Investment New Hospital Programme, diagnostics expansion, elective surgical hubs, and community diagnostic centres. Coordinates multi-billion capital pipeline with construction procurement, equipment sourcing, and operational readiness. Governance Procurement Governance PCR 2015 compliance, Social Value Act obligations, transparency requirements, and contract lifecycle management. Ensures every procurement route meets legal thresholds and audit-readiness standards. Counter Fraud Fraud & Corruption NHS Counter Fraud Authority oversight of procurement fraud, conflicts of interest, and financial irregularity. Monitors bid-rigging, cartel behaviour, and supplier integrity across NHS supply chains. Net Zero Sustainability NHS Net Zero 2040 commitment driving carbon footprint measurement, green procurement standards, and social value maximisation. Embeds environmental impact scoring into supplier selection and contract award criteria. Workforce Workforce Procurement Agency staffing, locum procurement, framework compliance, and rate capping enforcement. Addresses NHS workforce supply challenges while controlling temporary staffing spend across trusts and ICBs. Agency spend exceeds £3bn annually with significant rate variation and compliance gaps. Parliamentary Parliamentary DHSC accounting officer responsibilities, NAO value-for-money audits, PAC hearings, and annual accounts scrutiny. Provides parliamentary assurance on NHS procurement efficiency and taxpayer value. Subject to regular Select Committee inquiry and minist
